summary.text: Cory Chun was first elected to House District 35 in the Hawaii House of Representatives in November 2022.

paragraphs.text: Chun has served on the Waipahu Neighborhood Board since 2007, and previously was Policy and Budget Director and Senior Advisor to the Honolulu City Council Chair and Government Relations Director for the American Cancer Society Cancer Action Network.
Chun is a graduate of Iolani School, Gonzaga University, and the Gonzaga University School of Law.
